import { listNotesStoreConformance } from "../../../../application/notes/list-notes/list-notes.store.test-support.ts";
import { describeDrizzleStore } from "../drizzle-test-database.test-support.ts";
import { DrizzleCreateNoteStore } from "./create-note.store.ts";
import { DrizzleListNotesStore } from "./list-notes.store.ts";

describeDrizzleStore("DrizzleListNotesStore", (db) => {
  listNotesStoreConformance("DrizzleListNotesStore", async () => ({
    store: new DrizzleListNotesStore(db()),
    addNote: (note) => new DrizzleCreateNoteStore(db()).save(note),
  }));
});
